t-sbs-changed.note: T1 lineage: header + one changed row pair, `=`/`<>` markers

t-int-changed.note: same pair on interleaved: `<>` pair shares ONE block

t-summary-mixed.note: E/F lineage: 2 same + 1 important difference + 1 important right orphan

t-swap-tie.note: T13 tie direction: k3+- / k4= / -+k3 (anchor at EARLIER right index)

t-dups-positional.note: T14 duplicates consume positionally: two `=` then one `+-`

t-zip-gap.note: P1: 2x2 all-different gap zips to two `<>`, never four orphans

t-quoted-newline.note: T21: quoted embedded newline is ONE row; NUL in the display cell

t-ragged-cols.note: T18: global column count from the wider side; empty column on the left

t-nums-sbs.note: W1/W3: numeric cells right-justified per-side (widths from that side)

t-nums-int2digit.note: W3: interleaved number fields rjust to the digit width of the last row

t-eof-phantom.note: m64 E1: a blank line before EOF is a real right-orphan row on the right

t-letters-aa.note: m64c2 C2: 29 single-char columns; letters A..Z,AA,AB,AC set width floors

t-detect-tab.note: D6: non-.csv auto-detects the tab delimiter

t-detect-prio.note: G-tc: comma beats tab in the priority chain

t-rawline.note: S1: no candidate outside quotes -> rawline fallback, one cell per line

t-title.title: MyTitle
t-title.note: X4: title:"MyTitle" REPLACES the frame's first line

t-mixed-csvp.note: MX6: mixed .txt/.csv with NO comma anywhere -> ONE column: either file .csv pins fixed comma for BOTH files (docs/13 §8.2)

t-int-rawline.note: IR1: interleaved rawline -- leading whitespace dropped (SP10), single column, verbatim equality otherwise

t-int-num.note: IR3: numeric rawline cells left-justify in interleaved (T19/T21 rule holds for rawline too)
